Welcome to Dhaka, Bangladesh, home to the world's most intense traffic!!! In this video, I take every form of public transportation to see how everyday people are able to live in this organized chaos. What I've come to realize is that behind these crazy streets, you will meet the kindest, most hospitable people in South Asia. I hope you enjoy this adventure in Dhaka!
Huge thanks to my friend Nadir for taking me around your hometown! Check out his travel channel here:
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
